description: This PHP source file defines the class SugarSoapService2, a service class for version 2 of a SOAP API in the SuiteCRM project. It extends the NusoapSoap class and contains a method for registering available SOAP functions.

classes.name: SugarSoapService2
classes.description: A service class for version 2 of the SOAP API, extending NusoapSoap, responsible for registering available SOAP functions.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers all functions to be available for SOAP, excluding specified functions, and logs the process.
